title: RTX Mirrors (Variation)
description: this changes the White Glazed Terracotta, Light Gray Glazed Terracotta, and the Gray Glazed Terracotta to be mirrors. ranging from fully reflective, somewhat reflective, barely reflective.
body:
this mod makes the white, light gray, and gray Terracotta reflective, ranging from fully reflective to barely reflective. i hate mirror resource packs that only have 1 FULLY reflective block rather than a ranging variety of roughness values. so i made this that has 3 levels of reflectivity.

also for anyone wondering, the shader used was both IterationRP and VTXS_Screen_Space_Demo. both amazing shaders.
